positive_feedback: Layer separation is exactly the spec's three-layer design: crates/axc-driver/src/rewrite_verify.rs (Layer 0) is a pure orchestration function taking Option<&VulkanContext>, no LLM/network/CLI/JSON-RPC types anywhere in it. Layer 1 (cli.rs RewriteVerify arm + main.rs::run_rewrite_verify) and Layer 2 (mcp/tools/verify_rewrite.rs::handle) are thin callers over the same core — no duplicated dispatch or oracle logic between them.

Reuse map (§3.4) honored verbatim: compile_source_with_assignments, mcp::tools::compile_variant::{validate_spirv, bytes_to_words}, mcp::tools::bench_variant::{seeded_inputs, derive_workgroups, within_ulp_f32 promoted pub(crate)}, VulkanContext::{prepare_kernel_checked, dispatch_handle}. The core's dependency on mcp::tools::{bench_variant, compile_variant} for these utility fns is exactly what the spec's own reuse table (§3.4) directs, not an incidental layering leak; there is no reverse dependency (mcp/dispatch.rs, JSON-RPC types, clap types never appear in rewrite_verify.rs).

Verdict JSON schema (§5) matches the closed taxonomy exactly: Verdict enum SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE serialization verified by a dedicated unit test (verdict_serializes_screaming_snake_case), 'verdict' is declared as VerifyReport's first field (and AT-2842 asserts the RAW serialized string starts with {"verdict": rather than trusting a re-sorted serde_json::Value, correctly avoiding a false-pass). Every reason.kind string used in rewrite_verify.rs (compile_fail_{original,rewritten}, val_fail_{original,rewritten}, interface_mismatch, workgroups_required, push_constants_required, preflight_fail_rewritten, preflight_fail_original, original_nondeterministic, gpu_unavailable, coopmat_unsupported, device_feature_unsupported, numeric_mismatch, infra_error) is a 1:1 match to the spec's §5 reason.kind table, including stage placement.

InterfaceMismatch gates all three BufferAccess variants (ReadOnly/ReadWrite/WriteOnly) per §4.1, with AT-2848b explicitly proving a WriteOnly->ReadWrite flip is caught while AT-2848 proves a kernel_name rename is legal -- exactly the historical q4km_..._cached -> _cached_sr rewrite class the spec cites.

CLI surface (cli.rs RewriteVerify arm) is idiomatic against the existing Bench/Mcp subcommand patterns (same clap derive style, same --size shortcut restriction logic in main.rs::resolve_size_shortcut matching §3.2's non-coopmat/non-shared/same-ScalarTy restriction verbatim, including the 'trivial partial-coverage PASS' rationale from the spec text). emit_usage_error keeps the 'verdict JSON always on stdout' contract uniform even for pre-VerifyRequest usage failures, which the spec doesn't explicitly demand but is a faithful extension of §5's stated contract.

MCP tool (verify_rewrite.rs) implements the CRIT-2 governance mechanism exactly as specified: server-owned default via default_bit_exact, unconditional (any non-BitExact, not just 'looser') override flagging with a documented rationale, Vulkan-unavailable as a hard RPC error contrasted explicitly against the CLI's SKIPPED ergonomics -- both documented and justified in the module doc comment. dispatch.rs registration (METHOD_VERIFY_REWRITE, ALL_METHODS, initialize.tools list 6->7, narrow_and_run_ctx routing) follows the existing 6-tool pattern with no deviation.

Fixtures (saxpy_wrong.axc, saxpy_perturbed.axc, saxpy_reassoc.axc) match §7's descriptions verbatim (alpha*x-y; alpha*(1+1e-7)*x+y; y+alpha*x single-commutation, explicitly NOT a multi-term re-association), each fixture's header comment states its AT number and the exact intended verdict path, and saxpy_reassoc.axc is correctly non-coopmat/non-shared so it is the Lavapipe-reachable ACCEPT path per WARN-5.

DESIGN.md §3.1.42 and ROADMAP.md FG.1 updates are accurate, proportionate, and honest: they cross-reference the real measured GPU results (NVIDIA + Lavapipe, matching QA's independent re-run numbers exactly, e.g. the coopmat typed-skip kind divergence on this specific Lavapipe box), correctly state 'zero compiler changes', and do not overclaim beyond what AT-2841..2860 actually establish.

AT-2855's pinned-seed inline documentation (rewrite_verify_gpu.rs + DESIGN.md §3.1.42) is honest: it explains the seed=1 pin as a measured avoidance of the well-conditioned [-1,1] fill occasionally landing a near-zero denominator for the Relative policy at n=1024, not a quiet loosening of the pinned alpha=2.0/rel:1e-3 demonstration -- and the bit-exact FAIL leg under that same seed is independently confirmed to still fire (n_diff>0), so the non-vacuity guard is intact under the pinned seed.

The QA-identified AT-2849 coverage gap (governance stamp never exercised through the real handle() path) was closed cleanly in the follow-up commit 0d101a4: the new test drives the actual JSON-RPC verify_rewrite dispatch on Lavapipe, un-gated (following the existing at_1114/at_1115 precedent for GPU-backed MCP tests that run for real in CI rather than #[ignore]-gating), and asserts both the override-stamped and the default (un-stamped) legs. The old test's doc comment was updated to point at the new one rather than silently left stale.

minor_issues.description: `stage` and `reason.kind` are plain `String` rather than closed Rust enums, so the §5 exhaustiveness guarantee is enforced only by test coverage + code review, not the type system. Not a defect given the values are in fact a closed, well-tested set today, but a stringly-typed field is easier to silently drift out of the closed taxonomy in a future edit than an enum would be. Consider a follow-up (not blocking this milestone) to promote `stage`/`reason.kind` to enums with a `Display`/`serde` mapping.

`make_report` takes 8 positional arguments (with `#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]`), which is a little easy to transpose by accident (e.g. swapping `original`/`rewritten` KernelSummary args) since several are same-typed `Option<KernelSummary>`. Every call site was manually checked against this review and is correct, but a small builder or named-struct-args pattern would remove the transposition risk for future edits. Cosmetic, not blocking.

summary: M3.16 axc rewrite-verify implements the r2 spec with high fidelity across all three layers. Layer separation is clean (the core's only 'mcp' dependency is on the two specific utility modules the spec's own reuse map directs it to use, not on any CLI/JSON-RPC/dispatch machinery). The verdict JSON schema, closed reason.kind taxonomy, and InterfaceMismatch sub-kinds all match §5 exactly, verified against the actual source rather than the coder's self-report. CLI and MCP surfaces follow existing subcommand/tool idioms with no invented patterns. The reuse map is honored with zero duplicated dispatch/oracle logic. All three fixtures match §7 verbatim. DESIGN.md §3.1.42 and ROADMAP.md FG.1 are accurate and proportionate, and the AT-2855 pinned-seed documentation is honest about why the seed was pinned. The QA-flagged AT-2849 test-coverage gap was closed correctly in the follow-up commit, using the same un-gated Lavapipe-CI pattern as existing precedent tests. Two cosmetic quality suggestions noted (stringly-typed stage/reason.kind, many-positional-argument make_report) -- neither blocks approval.
